ModMetaData.name: Workbench Connect
ModMetaData.author: jungooji
ModMetaData.description:
Local fix of Workbench Connect.
Original by jungooji. Workshop: https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3524727262 Source: https://github.com/zzzz465/WorkbenchConnect
Linked workbenches share bills. Changing how many times a bill runs, or the "until you have" count, is copied to the other linked benches too.
Disable the Workshop copy (jungooji.workbenchconnect) while this one is active. Safe to add mid-game. Before removing the mod, unlink the benches. If you already removed it, save and load once.
This build keeps the original WorkbenchConnect assembly and class names so existing links still load.
